title: Honey Glazed Saudi Fish Curry
description: A fragrant, sweetsugared fish curry glazed with honey, cooked quickly in a pressure cooker for a lowcarb, SaudiArabian flair.

ingredients.name: Firm white fish fillets (cod or halibut)
ingredients.notes: cut into 2‑inch pieces, seasoned with salt and pepper

instructions: Season the fish pieces with salt and pepper and set aside.
Heat the olive oil in the pressure cooker using the sauté setting; add onion, garlic, and ginger, cooking until the onion is translucent.
Add the sliced red bell pepper and the mixed spice blend; sauté for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in the fish sauce, honey, and tamarind paste, letting the flavors meld for 30 seconds.
Pour in the coconut milk and water, bringing the mixture to a gentle simmer.
Gently fold the fish pieces into the sauce, ensuring they are mostly submerged; close the pressure cooker lid.
Cook on high pressure for 5 minutes, then perform a quick pressure release.
Open the lid carefully and give the curry a good stir; taste and season with additional salt if needed.
Serve hot, optionally garnished with fresh cilantro.
Enjoy your quick, low‑carb Saudi fish curry!
